cells.tense: You are at the point where what you are shows and you are not managing how it shows.
cells.ask: Say one true thing about what you make, to someone who will just take it in, and then stop talking and let it sit.
cells.core:
You hold heavy things without breaking, and bearing that weight has not made you hard. That is a kind of strength people lean on. What stands out right now is that you are not directing how any of it looks. The work is moving through you at full strength and you are not adding anything on top.

You can see the shape of something without having to name the shape to yourself first. That is not cleverness. You have understood something well enough that its pattern is just open to you, and you are working from that.

Keep it fed: put a piece of what you make in front of someone who will take it without adding to it. Not guarding the light — letting it be seen without rewriting it.
cells.sheetLine: What you are is showing, and you are not doing anything about it.
cells.verb: being what you already are, out loud
cells.place: where you hold weight and stay standing

cells.tense: You are pushing past what is here, bracing for a version that has not arrived yet.
cells.ask: Stop mid-sentence once today and let ten seconds of quiet pass before you fill it.
cells.core:
You bear more than anyone asked you to, and sustaining that has gone past steady into braced. Ahead of you there is a version where it all lands, where what you have been carrying finally gets understood, and you are living in that version instead of this one. So what comes off you stops being a light and becomes a beam you aim.

The strength is intact. It was not the problem. What is pulled tight is timing — you are spending endurance on weight nobody has handed you, and the people with you are working harder just to stay in the room.

Let this moment be enough before you load it with meaning. One exchange where you do not know yet what it becomes. That is the way back: not less brightness, just less aim.
cells.sheetLine: You are carrying weight that has not been handed to you yet.

cells.tense: You are standing at a door that closed behind you, still waiting for it to open.
cells.ask: Tell one person one thing you have already done, in plain words, and let them hear it without softening it.
cells.core:
You have done real things and you are not standing behind them. Putting your full weight on what you made did not go well, so you pulled back and called it modesty. The strength is still there — you can hold what is heavy — but the making has gone quiet. You are holding a door for something you already walked through.

This is not about confidence. The strength has not gone anywhere; it is just not getting air. Holding under an unlit lamp looks like nothing from the outside, and it is starting to look like nothing from the inside.

Pick the direction yourself, once. Not what is expected of you — what you are actually aimed at. Choosing one small thing and saying so is what refills the hold. Not pushing through. Choosing.
cells.sheetLine: You have weight you can carry and you are not letting it be seen.

cells.tense: The light is running right now and you are calling it somebody else's job.
cells.ask: Name one thing today that happens only because you are there, and say it without small words or a joke after it.
cells.core:
You hold the room up and you would say you are just doing what anyone would. Bearing it is real. Not bending is real. And the making comes through you — but when it comes up you hand it to the situation, or the group, or the fact that somebody had to. The thing is running. You are not saying it is yours.

What is underneath is simpler than you think. Something shows up in your day, and it is you who meets it. That is the whole of it. Naming it is not a promotion. It is just noticing you are the one at the door.

Let one thing be yours in plain words. Not a speech. One sentence, no joke riding behind it, and see what it is like to leave it standing there.
cells.sheetLine: You are already doing it. You are just not saying so.
cells.verb: being what you already are, out loud
cells.place: where you hold weight and stay standing
